message.content: {"B_expression":"-1/(2*(1+sqrt(1+r))**2)","C_expression":"(-1)*((1/(sqrt((1+u)**2 + r) + (1+u))) + (1/(sqrt(1+r) + 1))) / (sqrt((1+u)**2 + r) + sqrt(1+r))","derivation":"Retain the generation-1 program (D1) unchanged for generation 2. Local justification: With B = -1/(2*(1+sqrt(1+r))^2) and the current C, the increment g = r/2 + chi_r*chi_u*(r^2*B + u*r*C) achieves (i) exact pure-remainder cancellation at u=0 (g = sqrt(1+r)-1, so 2g+g^2-r = 0 identically), and (ii) near-cancellation of the cross term 2*u*g for small u, as confirmed by the generation-1 feedback showing whole residuals at the 1e-8 to 1e-9 level for |r|~1e-6, |u|~8e-3. The derivation of C: letting s=sqrt(1+r), S=sqrt((1+u)^2+r), a=1+u, the exact Newton step is g_exact = S - a. Writing S-a = r/(S+a), one needs r^2*B + u*r*C = r/(S+a) - r/2. The current C is a smooth closed-form that matches the O(u*r) correction without a u in the denominator, preserving C-infinity at u=0. Domain: both sqrt(1+r) and sqrt((1+u)^2+r) are positive and smooth on the open set r>-1, (1+u)^2+r>0; the closed outer rectangle |r|<=1/2, |u|<=1/4 satisfies 1+r>=1/2 and (1+u)^2+r>=1/16, so the bodies are analytic on a neighborhood of the rectangle. No new construction is warranted: the numerical feedback shows no instability, no drift, and no failure mode that a revised C would address. The ZERO family remains exactly z=1, r=0, u=0, g=0 regardless of B and C. Points with |u|>1/4 (e.g. the LEFT family edge rows with z far from 1) receive only the bare g=r/2 because chi_u=0 there; their large residuals are structural to the problem, not a defect of the coefficient field.","inspect":[],"note":"Retained unchanged. A successor at generation>=3 should check: (1) whether the tau^3*k2 target increment at W2 keeps all non-ZERO rows inside |r|<=1/2, |u|<=1/4 (the chi support); the UNIFORM and interior LEFT/RIGHT rows at t=1/64 have |u|~0.008 and |r|~1e-6, safely inside. (2) The edge rows (x=63/64, x=1/64) with signed sources can have |z|>>1, giving |u|>>1/4 where the bodies are inactive and only g=r/2 applies; large residuals there are expected and not a program failure. (3) The C expression uses sqrt((1+u)^2+r) which stays positive on the rectangle but would become singular if a future state drove (1+u)^2+r toward 0; no such state is visible in the current field. (4) No smoothness certificate is claimed beyond the composition-domain argument; the certificate field remains CONDITIONAL_SMOOTH_FAMILY. (5) This is a local coefficient-field operator for the two-slot covariance quotient at a fixed wave certificate, not a full PDE or NS theorem."}
